topic: Systematic Cleaning Procedure for a Vacant Departure Room
questionText:
Arrange the professional sequence followed by a Room Attendant when servicing a checkout guest room:
(A) Knock, announce housekeeping, enter, open curtains/windows for ventilation, and strip soiled bed/bath linens
(B) Make the bed with fresh crisp linens applying precise hospital mitered corners
(C) High dusting, cleaning all surfaces, sanitizing telephone, remotes, and restocking guest amenities
(D) Scrub, sanitize, and dry bathroom (toilet, tub, tiles), mop floor backward toward the exit, and conduct final inspection

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: B, A, C, D

Detailed Solution:
Servicing a room progresses: strip linen & ventilate (A) -> make bed with fresh linen (B) -> dust/sanitize bedroom (C) -> deep clean bathroom & mop outward (D).
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

questionText:
Read the following consumer rights case study and answer the questions that follow:

Sunita purchased an electric water geyser from a local home appliance store for Rs. 12,500. She paid the full amount in cash and received a printed cash memo. Within two weeks of installation, the geyser malfunctioned due to defective heating element insulation, giving her a severe electric shock. Upon examining the appliance closely, Sunita noticed that the geyser did not bear the mandatory ISI standardisation mark from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). When she approached the retail store owner demanding a replacement or full refund, the retailer flatly refused, pointing to a handwritten note on the receipt stating 'Goods once sold will not be taken back or exchanged'. Sunita consulted a Voluntary Consumer Organization (VCO) and filed an online consumer complaint on the e-Daakhil portal under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, claiming refund and compensation under Product Liability for mental agony and injury.

detailedSolution:

It guarantees that the appliance complies with national safety standards to protect users against electric shocks and fire hazards.

Electric water heaters involve risks of electrocution and fire hazards. Mandatory ISI certification from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) guarantees that the appliance adheres to national safety standards to prevent electrical shocks and operational hazards.

questionText:
Match the housekeeping section in List I with its operational function in List II:

List I:
(A) Housekeeping Control Desk
(B) Linen and Uniform Room
(C) Public Areas Section
(D) Horticulture / Florist Section

List II:
(I) Nerve center handling phone communications, guest requests, maintenance logs, and room status updates
(II) Storage, issuing, receiving, inventory tracking, and inspection of all hotel bed/bath linens and staff uniforms
(III) Cleaning and upkeep of hotel lobbies, corridors, elevators, restaurants, banquets, and public restrooms
(IV) Designing flower arrangements, maintaining indoor potted plants, and landscaping hotel gardens

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III

Control Desk handles communication/logs; Linen Room tracks fabrics/uniforms; Public Areas cleans lobbies/banquets; Horticulture manages floral landscaping.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
